welcome: You have not been here before, so: the four compass directions move you, and everything else you may simply write in plain words.

Look at things. Ask about things. Say what you mean to do. Every place in this valley answers to a good deal more than a list of verbs would suggest, and trying is the only way anyone has ever found out what.
Type help for the short list the world keeps of its own verbs. It is not the whole of it and it was never meant to be.
